course.title: Construction and Project Management - II
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A 5-m depth of sand overlies a 6-m thick layer of clay, the water table being at the ground surface, the permeability of the clay is very low. The saturated unit weight of the sand is 19 KN/m³ and that of the clay is 20 KN/m³. A 4-m depth of fill material of unit weight 20 ${ \mathsf { K N } } / { \mathsf { m } } ^ { 3 }$ is placed on the ground surface over an extensive area. Determine the effective vertical stress at the centre of the clay layer many years after the fill has been placed.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
